lines.gurmukhi: ਸੂਹੀ ਕਬੀਰ ਜੀਉ ਲਲਿਤ ॥
lines.transliteration: soohee kabeer jeeu lalit ||
lines.translation: Soohee, Kabeer Jee, Lallit:

lines.gurmukhi: ਥਾਕੇ ਨੈਨ ਸ੍ਰਵਨ ਸੁਨਿ ਥਾਕੇ ਥਾਕੀ ਸੁੰਦਰਿ ਕਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: thaake nain sravan sun thaake thaakee su(n)dar kaaiaa ||
lines.translation: My eyes are exhausted, and my ears are tired of hearing; my beautiful body is exhausted.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਰਾ ਹਾਕ ਦੀ ਸਭ ਮਤਿ ਥਾਕੀ ਏਕ ਨ ਥਾਕਸਿ ਮਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: jaraa haak dee sabh mat thaakee ek na thaakas maaiaa ||1||
lines.translation: Driven forward by old age, all my senses are exhausted; only my attachment to Maya is not exhausted. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਾਵਰੇ ਤੈ ਗਿਆਨ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: baavare tai giaan beechaar na paaiaa ||
lines.translation: O mad man, you have not obtained spiritual wisdom and meditation.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਰਥਾ ਜਨਮੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: birathaa janam gavaaiaa ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: You have wasted this human life, and lost. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਬ ਲਗੁ ਪ੍ਰਾਨੀ ਤਿਸੈ ਸਰੇਵਹੁ ਜਬ ਲਗੁ ਘਟ ਮਹਿ ਸਾਸਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: tab lag praanee tisai sarevahu jab lag ghat mahi saasaa ||
lines.translation: O mortal, serve the Lord, as long as the breath of life remains in the body.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੇ ਘਟੁ ਜਾਇ ਤ ਭਾਉ ਨ ਜਾਸੀ ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਚਰਨ ਨਿਵਾਸਾ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: je ghat jaai ta bhaau na jaasee har ke charan nivaasaa ||2||
lines.translation: And even when your body dies, your love for the Lord shall not die; you shall dwell at the Feet of the Lord. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਸ ਕਉ ਸਬਦੁ ਬਸਾਵੈ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਚੂਕੈ ਤਿਸਹਿ ਪਿਆਸਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: jis kau sabad basaavai a(n)tar chookai tisahi piaasaa ||
lines.translation: When the Word of the Shabad abides deep within, thirst and desire are quenched.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹੁਕਮੈ ਬੂਝੈ ਚਉਪੜਿ ਖੇਲੈ ਮਨੁ ਜਿਣਿ ਢਾਲੇ ਪਾਸਾ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: hukamai boojhai chaupaR khelai man jin dhaale paasaa ||3||
lines.translation: When one understands the Hukam of the Lord's Command, he plays the game of chess with the Lord; throwing the dice, he conquers his own mind. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਜਨ ਜਾਨਿ ਭਜਹਿ ਅਬਿਗਤ ਕਉ ਤਿਨ ਕਾ ਕਛੂ ਨ ਨਾਸਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: jo jan jaan bhajahi abigat kau tin kaa kachhoo na naasaa ||
lines.translation: Those humble beings, who know the Imperishable Lord and meditate on Him, are not destroyed at all.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਕਬੀਰ ਤੇ ਜਨ ਕਬਹੁ ਨ ਹਾਰਹਿ ਢਾਲਿ ਜੁ ਜਾਨਹਿ ਪਾਸਾ ॥੪॥੪॥
lines.transliteration: kahu kabeer te jan kabahu na haarahi dhaal j jaanahi paasaa ||4||4||
lines.translation: Says Kabeer, those humble beings who know how to throw these dice, never lose the game of life. ||4||4||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੂਹੀ ਲਲਿਤ ਕਬੀਰ ਜੀਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: soohee lalit kabeer jeeu ||
lines.translation: Soohee, Lalit, Kabeer Jee:

lines.gurmukhi: ਏਕੁ ਕੋਟੁ ਪੰਚ ਸਿਕਦਾਰਾ ਪੰਚੇ ਮਾਗਹਿ ਹਾਲਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: ek kot pa(n)ch sikadaaraa pa(n)che maagahi haalaa ||
lines.translation: In the one fortress of the body, there are five rulers, and all five demand payment of taxes.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਮੀ ਨਾਹੀ ਮੈ ਕਿਸੀ ਕੀ ਬੋਈ ਐਸਾ ਦੇਨੁ ਦੁਖਾਲਾ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: jimee naahee mai kisee kee boee aisaa den dukhaalaa ||1||
lines.translation: I have not farmed anyone's land, so such payment is difficult for me to pay. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਲੋਗਾ ਮੋ ਕਉ ਨੀਤਿ ਡਸੈ ਪਟਵਾਰੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: har ke logaa mo kau neet dasai patavaaree ||
lines.translation: O people of the Lord, the tax-collector is constantly torturing me!

lines.gurmukhi: ਊਪਰਿ ਭੁਜਾ ਕਰਿ ਮੈ ਗੁਰ ਪਹਿ ਪੁਕਾਰਿਆ ਤਿਨਿ ਹਉ ਲੀਆ ਉਬਾਰੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: oopar bhujaa kar mai gur pahi pukaariaa tin hau leeaa ubaaree ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: Raising my arms up, I complained to my Guru, and He has saved me. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਉ ਡਾਡੀ ਦਸ ਮੁੰਸਫ ਧਾਵਹਿ ਰਈਅਤਿ ਬਸਨ ਨ ਦੇਹੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: nau daadee das mu(n)saph dhaavahi raeeat basan na dehee ||
lines.translation: The nine tax-assessors and the ten magistrates go out; they do not allow their subjects to live in peace.

lines.gurmukhi: ਡੋਰੀ ਪੂਰੀ ਮਾਪਹਿ ਨਾਹੀ ਬਹੁ ਬਿਸਟਾਲਾ ਲੇਹੀ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: doree pooree maapahi naahee bahu bisataalaa lehee ||2||
lines.translation: They do not measure with a full tape, and they take huge amounts in bribes. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਹਤਰਿ ਘਰ ਇਕੁ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਸਮਾਇਆ ਉਨਿ ਦੀਆ ਨਾਮੁ ਲਿਖਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: bahatar ghar ik purakh samaaiaa un deeaa naam likhaaee ||
lines.translation: The One Lord is contained in the seventy-two chambers of the body, and He has written off my account.

lines.gurmukhi: ਧਰਮ ਰਾਇ ਕਾ ਦਫਤਰੁ ਸੋਧਿਆ ਬਾਕੀ ਰਿਜਮ ਨ ਕਾਈ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: dharam raai kaa daphatar sodhiaa baakee rijam na kaaee ||3||
lines.translation: The records of the Righteous Judge of Dharma have been searched, and I owe absolutely nothing. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੰਤਾ ਕਉ ਮਤਿ ਕੋਈ ਨਿੰਦਹੁ ਸੰਤ ਰਾਮੁ ਹੈ ਏਕੋੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: sa(n)taa kau mat koee ni(n)dahu sa(n)t raam hai ekou ||
lines.translation: Let no one slander the Saints, because the Saints and the Lord are as one.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਕਬੀਰ ਮੈ ਸੋ ਗੁਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਜਾ ਕਾ ਨਾਉ ਬਿਬੇਕੋੁ ॥੪॥੫॥
lines.transliteration: kahu kabeer mai so gur paaiaa jaa kaa naau bibekou ||4||5||
lines.translation: Says Kabeer, I have found that Guru, whose Name is Clear Understanding. ||4||5||

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਾਗੁ ਸੂਹੀ ਬਾਣੀ ਸ੍ਰੀ ਰਵਿਦਾਸ ਜੀਉ ਕੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: raag soohee baanee sree ravidaas jeeu kee ||
lines.translation: Raag Soohee, The Word Of Sree Ravi Daas Jee:

lines.gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
lines.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਹ ਕੀ ਸਾਰ ਸੁਹਾਗਨਿ ਜਾਨੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: sah kee saar suhaagan jaanai ||
lines.translation: The happy soul-bride knows the worth of her Husband Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਜਿ ਅਭਿਮਾਨੁ ਸੁਖ ਰਲੀਆ ਮਾਨੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: taj abhimaan sukh raleeaa maanai ||
lines.translation: Renouncing pride, she enjoys peace and pleasure.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਦੇਇ ਨ ਅੰਤਰੁ ਰਾਖੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: tan man dei na a(n)tar raakhai ||
lines.translation: She surrenders her body and mind to Him, and does not remain separate from Him.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਵਰਾ ਦੇਖਿ ਨ ਸੁਨੈ ਅਭਾਖੈ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: avaraa dekh na sunai abhaakhai ||1||
lines.translation: She does not see or hear, or speak to another. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਕਤ ਜਾਨੈ ਪੀਰ ਪਰਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: so kat jaanai peer paraaee ||
lines.translation: How can anyone know the pain of another,

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਦਰਦੁ ਨ ਪਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: jaa kai a(n)tar darad na paaee ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: if there is no compassion and sympathy within? ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਦੁਖੀ ਦੁਹਾਗਨਿ ਦੁਇ ਪਖ ਹੀਨੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: dukhee duhaagan dui pakh heenee ||
lines.translation: The discarded bride is miserable, and loses both worlds;

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਿ ਨਾਹ ਨਿਰੰਤਰਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਨ ਕੀਨੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: jin naah nira(n)tar bhagat na keenee ||
lines.translation: she does not worship her Husband Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪੁਰ ਸਲਾਤ ਕਾ ਪੰਥੁ ਦੁਹੇਲਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: pur salaat kaa pa(n)th duhelaa ||
lines.translation: The bridge over the fire of hell is difficult and treacherous.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੰਗਿ ਨ ਸਾਥੀ ਗਵਨੁ ਇਕੇਲਾ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: sa(n)g na saathee gavan ikelaa ||2||
lines.translation: No one will accompany you there; you will have to go all alone. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਦੁਖੀਆ ਦਰਦਵੰਦੁ ਦਰਿ ਆਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: dukheeaa daradava(n)d dar aaiaa ||
lines.translation: Suffering in pain, I have come to Your Door, O Compassionate Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਹੁਤੁ ਪਿਆਸ ਜਬਾਬੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: bahut piaas jabaab na paaiaa ||
lines.translation: I am so thirsty for You, but You do not answer me.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਹਿ ਰਵਿਦਾਸ ਸਰਨਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤੇਰੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: kahi ravidaas saran prabh teree ||
lines.translation: Says Ravi Daas, I seek Your Sanctuary, God;

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਉ ਜਾਨਹੁ ਤਿਉ ਕਰੁ ਗਤਿ ਮੇਰੀ ॥੩॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: jiu jaanahu tiu kar gat meree ||3||1||
lines.translation: as You know me, so will You save me. ||3||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੂਹੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: soohee ||
lines.translation: Soohee:

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਦਿਨ ਆਵਹਿ ਸੋ ਦਿਨ ਜਾਹੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: jo din aavahi so din jaahee ||
lines.translation: That day which comes, that day shall go.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਰਨਾ ਕੂਚੁ ਰਹਨੁ ਥਿਰੁ ਨਾਹੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: karanaa kooch rahan thir naahee ||
lines.translation: You must march on; nothing remains stable.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੰਗੁ ਚਲਤ ਹੈ ਹਮ ਭੀ ਚਲਨਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: sa(n)g chalat hai ham bhee chalanaa ||
lines.translation: Our companions are leaving, and we must leave as well.

lines.gurmukhi: ਦੂਰਿ ਗਵਨੁ ਸਿਰ ਊਪਰਿ ਮਰਨਾ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: door gavan sir oopar maranaa ||1||
lines.translation: We must go far away. Death is hovering over our heads. ||1||
